entries.appliesTo: Department of Education and local school boards (public elementary and secondary schools)

dutySources.risk-program: § 22.1-20.2:1(C) — 'Each school board shall establish, implement, and enforce policies consistent with the guidance developed by the Department pursuant to subsection B.'

sources.policyRequired: § 22.1-20.2:1(C) — 'Each school board shall establish, implement, and enforce policies consistent with the guidance developed by the Department pursuant to subsection B.'
sources.trainingRequired: § 22.1-20.2:1(D)(3) — 'Require each school division selected for participation in the Pilot Program to (i) include professional development for educators on AIS literacy and responsible use'

flags: trainingRequired binds only school divisions selected for the Pilot Program, not all divisions (§ D(3))
Department of Education must compile information on current AIS uses and publish safe/ethical/equitable-use guidance on its website (§ B) — agency duty with no matching duty key
Department must establish and oversee the AIS Innovation in Education Pilot Program, contingent on appropriations ('With such funds as are appropriated for such purpose') (§ D)
annual report to Chairs of House Committee on Education and Senate Committee on Education and Health by December 1 of each year (§ D(4)) — legislative reporting fits no duty key
Pilot Program provisions (subsection D) expire July 1, 2030 (enactment clause 2)

school board policy content is set by Department guidance rather than by the statute itself; guidance must address data-privacy agreements prohibiting use of division-level or student data for training external AIS models (§ B(1)(d))
no penalty or enforcement provision — exposure omitted
